# Definitional Conflict

This folder documents instances where the clinical narrative in annual reports conflicts with rigid technical data definitions, creating measurement ambiguity. Currently, it contains a single documented case involving Indicator 7, where the broad clinical goal of quickly resuming oral nutrition does not perfectly align with the strict ZZ2009C/D coding requirements mandated in March 2024. Because the underlying data for this theme is thin, the folder serves as a precise record of this specific coding-versus-intent discrepancy.

## Pages

- [[definitional-conflict|Definitional Conflict]] — Documents the ambiguity created when the clinical goal of resuming oral nutrition conflicts with the strict ZZ2009C/D coding requirements for Indicator 7.
